text:
You need a reliable way to generate many house music tracks, pick the strongest ones, layer in provided lyrics, and turn them into polished hour-long sets with AI support.

Hi Danny — I’m Noor Halden, and I’m excited by this kind of creative, systems-driven workflow. I have 6 years of experience working with Python and machine learning, and I’m comfortable using AI tools to automate parts of a process while still keeping quality control front and center. For this role, I’d bring a mix of technical ability, careful selection judgment, and a practical approach to using AI as an assistant rather than a replacement.

A relevant project was Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics, where I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant that tracks parcels, reschedules deliveries, and hands off to a human with full context. That project used Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio, and it resolved 43% of conversations without an agent while maintaining a CSAT of 4.4 out of 5. Another project was Coffee review themes for Cobalt Coffee Roasters, where I built a small Streamlit app that grouped 38k marketplace reviews into themes and tracked sentiment per theme each week. That work identified 12 stable themes and replaced about 2 days a month of manual tagging. Those projects show I’m comfortable building workflows that filter large volumes of output into something useful and consistent.

While my background is in Python, NLP, and machine learning rather than traditional DAW production, I’m very interested in electronic music and in using AI tools to support creative production. I’m especially drawn to the part of this job where tracks are generated at volume, then evaluated and assembled into complete sets. That sounds like a great fit for a structured, iterative workflow.

I can work full-time, and I’d be happy to discuss how you want the track selection, lyric layering, and set assembly process organized. What tools are you currently using for generating tracks and mixing the hour-long sets?
